description: Use this when a user asks which version of the Open Footprint standard they are designing against, or which extension packs this snapshot publishes. Reports the source commit plus a packs summary: each pack's id, kind, version, status (placeholder/draft/approved/dormant/withdrawn), the core range it extends and the regulations it serves, and whether any pack is approved. Gate adoption on status — a draft pack is published for review, not for adoption.
name: ofp_model_provenance
title: Open Footprint: model version
